$comment: The generated portfolio cover sheet (M42). Data, not code — edit the wording, the sizes and which columns the contents table lists, and the next 'Regenerate cover sheet' uses them. Placeholders: {title} the portfolio's name, {subtitle} whatever the reader typed, {date} today in en-GB, {count} '3 files in 2 folders', {size} the total size. A text of "" leaves that line out. Sizes are points; margins are millimetres; column widths are fractions of the text width and are scaled to fill it.

intro.text: This document is a PDF Portfolio holding {count} ({size}). Open it in a reader that supports portfolios to see the files listed below; each one is embedded whole and unchanged.
